preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 1 and 300,000 inclusive.
The number of edges m is between 0 and 300,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u_i <= n and 1 <= v_i <= n and u_i != v_i for u_i, v_i, w_i in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the range 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= w_i <= 10**9 for u_i, v_i, w_i in edges)
preconditions.description: The weight of each edge is between 1 and 1,000,000,000 inclusive.
The start vertex u is between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: total_weight == sum(w_i for u_i, v_i, w_i in selected_edges)
postconditions.description: The total weight is the sum of the weights of the selected edges.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= edge_index <= m for edge_index in edge_indices)
postconditions.description: Each edge index in the output is between 1 and m inclusive.
The number of selected edges is n - 1, forming a tree.

postconditions.expression: all(u in vertices and v in vertices for u, v, w in selected_edges)
postconditions.description: Each selected edge connects vertices within the graph.

postconditions.expression: all(shortest_path_length(u, v, selected_edges) == shortest_path_length(u, v, edges) for v in vertices if v != u)
postconditions.description: The shortest path lengths from u to any other vertex in the selected edges are the same as in the original graph.
